preconditions.description: The grid size n is an integer between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == n + 1 and all(len(line) == n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input consists of n+1 lines: the first line is n, followed by n lines of exactly n characters each.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'.', 'S', 'G'} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either empty ('.'), sinoper ('S'), or glaucous ('G').

postconditions.description: The first line of output is either 'UNIQUE', 'NONE', or 'MULTIPLE', indicating the uniqueness, impossibility, or multiplicity of valid mastapeece completions.
If the output is 'UNIQUE', exactly n additional lines follow, each with n characters ('S' or 'G'), representing the unique valid mastapeece.

postconditions.expression: all(c in {'S', 'G'} for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] if stdout.strip() == 'UNIQUE' for c in line)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'UNIQUE', the following n lines consist only of 'S' or 'G' characters.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'NONE') or (stdout.strip() == 'MULTIPLE') or (all_adjacent_exactly_two(stdout.splitlines()[1:]) if stdout.strip() == 'UNIQUE' else True)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'UNIQUE', the provided grid satisfies the mastapeece condition: every tile (including original and filled) has exactly 2 adjacent tiles of the same color. For 'NONE' or 'MULTIPLE', no such condition is enforced on the output.
